verdict.rationale: The story is about bulk-acting on many managed items at once, such as records or resources in a software product. That is a category error for a discrete GPU, which has no item collection to act on. The evidence shows no such capability: parallel-compute libraries like rocPRIM are developer building blocks for kernels, and HYPR-RX one-click profiles toggle driver features, so neither makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
